narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The star has six tips, so Step one has six sides.
<bookmark mark='tip'/>Look at one tip, which has two sides, one going up and one coming down.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Counting tips misses half of the sides, so that bubble is wrong.
removed_beats.on_screen: the hint card leaves; a six tipped star appears; Chintu's bubble shows 6 sides; one tip lights up with its two sides; the bubble is struck in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='c1'/>To check, count the sides. Each step multiplies them by four.
<bookmark mark='c2'/>Each new side is one third as long as the side before it.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor and the three steps; two check lines appear: sides × 4 each step; each new side is 1/3 as long

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu sees six tips on the star and says Step one has six sides. Each tip has two sides, so the bubble is struck.
